description: Save a reusable procedure as a private SKILL.md. Supply only the procedure's Markdown body as instructions; frontmatter is generated from name, description and O++ metadata. It never runs itself, grants permission or publishes. Writes to your Personal Space unless space_id names another, creating Personal when needed.

idempotency_key.description: A stable string of 8 to 200 bytes you choose for this write. Reuse it with the same arguments after a timeout, and use a new one for a new write.

instructions.description: The complete generated SKILL.md must fit within 32,768 UTF-8 bytes, including generated frontmatter and these instructions.

content.description: Exact relevant text excerpt from the authorized source; never provider metadata, tokens, or credentials.

media_type.description: Format of the exact bounded text excerpt.

note.description: Short provenance note describing the selected source and excerpt.

observed_at.description: Observation time in an RFC 3339 profile with uppercase T/Z, full seconds, and explicit Z or ±HH:MM timezone. Fractions must be exactly representable as milliseconds (extra fractional digits may only be zeros). Saved as UTC with three fractional digits.

source_id.description: Stable lowercase identifier used to cite this evidence.

source_type.description: The kind of source read by the authenticated caller or O++ verified source broker.

uri.description: Credential-free canonical source URI or permalink; never include access tokens.

space_id.description: A private Space from space_list. Omit for your Personal Space.

name: skill_create
title: Save a private skill
